qs.s: Elle a un ___ de personnalité très créatif.
qs.en: She has a very creative personality type.

qs.en: We need to identify the type of problem before looking for a solution.

qs.en: There are several kinds of edible mushrooms in this forest.

qs.s: Quel ___ de cuisine préfères-tu, l'italienne ou la japonaise ?
qs.en: What kind of cuisine do you prefer, Italian or Japanese?

qs.en: He's a funny guy, he always wears a red hat.

qs.en: What is the type of relationship you have with him?

qs.s: C'est ___ type de situation que je n'avais jamais prévu.
qs.en: It's a type of situation I had never anticipated.

qs.en: She set herself a clear goal: to finish her studies before the age of thirty.

qs.en: He finally reached his goal after years of effort.

qs.s: Il a voyagé en France dans le ___ d'apprendre la langue.
qs.en: He traveled to France with the purpose of learning the language.

qs.s: Quel est le ___ de cette réunion ?
qs.en: What is the purpose of this meeting?

qs.en: The player scored a goal in the last minute of the match.

qs.s: Le gardien de ___ a arrêté tous les tirs adverses.
qs.en: The goalkeeper stopped all the opposing shots.

qs.en: At five in the morning, the sky begins to turn pink on the horizon.

qs.en: She gets up early every morning to meditate at sunrise.

qs.en: The meeting is scheduled for ten o'clock in the morning.

qs.s: Il a passé tout le ___ à travailler sur son rapport au bureau.
qs.en: He spent the whole morning working on his report at the office.

qs.s: ___ matin est la meilleure période de la journée pour faire du sport.

qs.en: He woke up one morning in a very good mood.
